facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: 18-month tailored scaling/fundraising program + $1M+ perks; no standard guaranteed cash investment
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 2.5% common equity stake; no program fee and no board seat
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Global founders accepted; travel required for in-person pitch events
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Tech-driven scalable software business; revenue-generating seed stage with MRR; at least one full-time founder and in-house technical lead; venture-backable; 5–6 hours/month commitment.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site Required: Virtual available; travel for pitch events
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 18 months, DMZ Toronto with virtual option; required progress/mentorship sessions and relevant pitch events.
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
facts_raw.Notes: Global startup ecosystem; verify exact current program.
